fields.help_en:
Purpose 1: After you complete the self-classification permission application (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/message-classification-0000001149358835?#section3410731125514), this parameter is used to identify the message type, determine the message reminder method (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/message-classification-0000001149358835#ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000001149358835__p3850133955718), and accelerate the sending of specific types of messages. For valid values, refer to the message classification standards (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/message-classification-0000001149358835#section1076611477914) in the official Huawei push documentation, and fill in the "Cloud notification category value" or "Local notification category value" in the document table.

Purpose 2: After you apply for special permissions (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/faq-0000001050042183#section037425218509), this parameter is used to identify high-priority pass-through scenarios. Valid values:
VOIP: audio and video calls
PLAY_VOICE: voice broadcast

If the "Cloud notification category value" is "Not applicable", the message is sent through the Alibaba Cloud proprietary channel. If the "Local notification category value" is "Not applicable", the message is sent through the Huawei channel
fields.help_zh:
作用一：完成自分类权益申请 (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/message-classification-0000001149358835?#section3410731125514)后，用于标识消息类型，确定消息提醒方式 (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/message-classification-0000001149358835#ZH-CN_TOPIC_0000001149358835__p3850133955718)，对特定类型消息加快发送，取值请参考华为推送官方文档的消息分类标准 (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/message-classification-0000001149358835#section1076611477914)，填写文档表格中的“云端通知category取值”或“本地通知category取值”。

作用二：申请特殊权限 (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/development/HMSCore-Guides/faq-0000001050042183#section037425218509)后，用于标识高优先级透传场景，取值如下：
VOIP：音视频通话
PLAY_VOICE：语音播报

对于“云端通知category取值”为“不涉及”的一概走阿里云自有通道，对于“本地通知category取值”为“不涉及”的一概走华为通道

fields.help_en:
OPPO message categorization includes two categories for management: Communication and Service, and Content and Marketing.

Communication and Service (permission application required):
IM: instant chat, audio calls, and video calls
ACCOUNT: individual account and asset changes
DEVICE_REMINDER: personal device reminders
ORDER: personal order and logistics status changes
TODO: personal schedules and to-do lists
SUBSCRIPTION: individual subscribe

Content and Marketing:
NEWS: news and information
CONTENT: content recommendations
MARKETING: platform campaigns
SOCIAL: social updates

For more information, see OPUSH message classification rules (https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=13189)
fields.help_zh:
OPPO将消息分类：通讯与服务、内容与营销两个类别进行管理。

通讯与服务（需申请权限）：
IM：即时聊天、音频、视频通话
ACCOUNT：个人账号与资产变化
DEVICE_REMINDER：个人设备提醒
ORDER：个人订单/物流状态变化
TODO：个人日程/待办
SUBSCRIPTION：个人订阅

内容与营销：
NEWS：新闻资讯
CONTENT：内容推荐
MARKETING：平台活动
SOCIAL：社交动态

详细请参考OPUSH消息分类细则 (https://open.oppomobile.com/new/developmentDoc/info?id=13189)
fields.name: android_message_oppo_category

fields.help_en:

1: notification bar
2: notification bar, lock screen, ringtone, and vibration (default notification level for Communication and Service messages)
16: notification bar, lock screen, ringtone, vibration, and banner (permission application required)

When you use the AndroidMessageOppoNotifyLevel parameter, you must also pass the AndroidMessageOppoCategory parameter
fields.help_zh:
OPPO通道通知栏消息提醒等级。可取值为：
1：通知栏
2：通知栏、锁屏、铃声、振动（通讯与服务类消息默认通知级别）
16：通知栏、锁屏、铃声、振动、横幅（需申请权限）

使用AndroidMessageOppoNotifyLevel参数时，必须同时传AndroidMessageOppoCategory参数
fields.name: android_message_oppo_notify_level

fields.help_en:
The expiration time of offline messages or notifications. This parameter is used together with StoreOffline. Expired messages or notifications are not sent. The maximum retention period is 72 hours. Default value: 72 hours.
Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC. The expiration time cannot be earlier than the current time or the scheduled sending time plus 3 seconds (`ExpireTime > PushTime + 3 seconds`). The 3-second buffer is used to compensate for network and system latency. We recommend that you set the expiration time to at least 1 minute for single pushes and at least 10 minutes for full pushes and batch pushes
fields.help_zh:
离线消息/通知的过期时间，和StoreOffline配合使用，过期则不会再被发送，最长保存72小时。默认为72小时。

VOIP: audio and video calls.
SUBSCRIPTION: subscribe.
TRAVEL: travel.
HEALTH: health.
WORK: work reminders.
ACCOUNT: account updates.
EXPRESS: orders and logistics.
FINANCE: finance.
DEVICE_REMINDER: device reminders.
MAIL: emails.
CUSTOMER_SERVICE: customer service messages.
MARKETING: news, content recommendations, social updates, product promotions, financial updates, lifestyle information, surveys, feature recommendations, and operational activity. This category only identifies the content and does not accelerate the message send. These are collectively referred to as information and marketing messages.

For details, see Notification.category (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V5#section17371529101117) on the HarmonyOS official website

SUBSCRIPTION：订阅

ACCOUNT：账号动态

fields.help_en:
The unique identifier of each message when the notification is displayed. If this parameter is not specified, the push service automatically generates a unique identifier for each message. Different notification messages can have the same notifyId to allow new messages to overwrite old ones.

For more information, see Notification.notifyId (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V5#section17371529101117) on the HarmonyOS official website
fields.help_zh:
每条消息在通知显示时的唯一标识。不携带时，推送服务自动为每条消息生成一个唯一标识；不同的通知消息可以拥有相同的notifyId，实现新消息覆盖旧消息功能。

详情参见鸿蒙官网 Notification.notifyId (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V5#section17371529101117)
fields.name: harmony_notify_id

fields.help_en:
The receipt ID for the HarmonyOS channel. You can view this receipt ID in the receipt parameter settings of the HarmonyOS channel push operations platform.

If the default receipt configured on the HarmonyOS channel push operations platform is the Alibaba Cloud receipt, you do not need to provide this parameter. Otherwise, we recommend that you configure the default receipt ID for the HarmonyOS channel in the Alibaba Cloud EMAS shift Push console first.

For details, see pushOptions.receiptId (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V5#section418321011212) on the HarmonyOS official website
fields.help_zh:
鸿蒙通道回执ID，该回执ID可以在鸿蒙通道推送运营平台的回执参数配置中查看。

如果在鸿蒙通道推送运营平台配置的默认回执配置是阿里云回执，则无需提供，如果不是，建议优先在阿里云EMAS移动推送控制台中配置鸿蒙通道默认回执ID。

详情参见鸿蒙官网 pushOptions.receiptId (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V5#section418321011212)
fields.name: harmony_receipt_id

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to use the auxiliary pop-up window feature when the device is offline and the push type is message. Default value: false. This parameter takes effect only when PushType is set to MESSAGE.
If the message is successfully converted to a notification and pushed, the notification displays the data specified by the HarmonyRemindTitle and HarmonyRemindBody parameters on the server
fields.help_zh:
推送类型为消息时设备不在线，则这条推送会使用辅助弹窗功能。默认值为false，仅当PushType=MESSAGE时生效。

如果消息转通知推送成功，收到通知是展示的数据为服务端设置的HarmonyRemindTitle和HarmonyRemindBody参数值
fields.name: harmony_remind

fields.example: 您有一条新消息，请查收
fields.help_en: The HarmonyOS notification content used when a HarmonyOS message is converted to a notification. This parameter takes effect only when HarmonyRemind is set to true
fields.help_zh: Harmony消息转通知时使用的Harmony通知内容，仅当HarmonyRemind为true时有效
fields.name: harmony_remind_body

fields.help_en: The HarmonyOS notification title used when a HarmonyOS message is converted to a notification. This parameter takes effect only when HarmonyRemind is set to true
fields.help_zh: Harmony消息转通知时使用的Harmony通知标题，仅当HarmonyRemind为true时有效
fields.name: harmony_remind_title

fields.help_en:
The style of the notification message. Valid values:
NORMAL: normal notification. This is the default value.
MULTI_LINE: multi-line text style
fields.help_zh:
通知消息样式：
NORMAL: 普通通知（默认值）
MULTI_LINE: 多行文本样式
fields.name: harmony_render_style

fields.help_en:
The test message identifier. Valid values:

false: normal message. This is the default value.
true: test message.

For more information, see pushOptions.testMessage (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V5#section418321011212) on the HarmonyOS official website
fields.help_zh:
测试消息标识：

false：正常消息（默认值）
true：测试消息

详情参见鸿蒙官网 pushOptions.testMessage (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V5#section418321011212)
fields.name: harmony_test_message

fields.help_en:
The URI corresponding to the ability of the built-in page in the app.
<notice>When HarmonyActionType is set to APP_CUSTOM_PAGE, you must specify at least one of the HarmonyUri and HarmonyAction fields. If multiple abilities exist, specify the action and URI for each ability. The action is preferentially used to find the corresponding built-in page in the app.></notice>

For more information, see ClickAction.uri (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V5#section152462191216) on the HarmonyOS official website
fields.help_zh:
应用内置页面ability对应的uri。
<notice>当HarmonyActionType为APP_CUSTOM_PAGE时，字段HarmonyUri和HarmonyAction至少填写一个。当存在多个Ability时，分别填写不同Ability的action和uri，优先使用action查找对应的应用内置页面。></notice>

详情参见鸿蒙官网 ClickAction.uri (https://developer.huawei.com/consumer/cn/doc/harmonyos-references-V5/push-scenariozed-api-request-param-V5#section152462191216)
fields.name: harmony_uri

fields.help_en: The custom identifier of the push task. If JobKey is not empty, this field is included in the receipt log. For more information about receipt logs, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434651.html
fields.help_zh: 推送任务自定义标识，当JobKey不为空时，回执日志中会附带该字段。查看回执日志参见https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/434651.html
fields.name: job_key

fields.help_en:
The scheduled sending time. If this parameter is not set, the message is sent immediately.
Specify the time in the ISO 8601 standard in the YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ format. The time must be in UTC
fields.help_zh:
用于定时发送。不设置缺省是立即发送。

时间格式按照ISO8601标准表示，并需要使用UTC时间，格式为YYYY-MM-DDThh:mm:ssZ
fields.name: push_time

fields.help_en:
The push type. Valid values:
MESSAGE: message
NOTICE: notification
fields.help_zh:
推送类型。取值：

MESSAGE：表示消息。
NOTICE：表示通知
fields.name: push_type

fields.help_en:
The specified sending channels. Valid values:
accs: Alibaba Cloud proprietary channel
huawei: Huawei channel
honor: Honor channel
xiaomi: Xiaomi channel
oppo: OPPO channel
vivo: vivo channel
meizu: Meizu channel
gcm: Google GCM channel (legacy HTTP)
fcm: Google Firebase channel (HTTP v1 API)
apns: APNs channel
harmony: HarmonyOS channel

If this parameter is not configured, all channels are available.
If this parameter is configured, only the specified channels are used.
If the configured channels conflict with the sending policy (for example, iOS notifications are sent only through the APNs channel, but apns is not included in this parameter), the message is not sent.
If gcm is configured, both Google GCM and FCM channels can be used. If fcm is configured, only the Google FCM channel can be used
fields.help_zh:
指定发送通道，取值如下：

accs：阿里云自有通道
huawei：华为通道
honor：荣耀通道
xiaomi：小米通道
oppo：OPPO通道
vivo：vivo通道
meizu：魅族通道
gcm：谷歌GCM通道（旧版HTTP）
fcm: 谷歌Firebase通道（HTTP v1 API）
apns：APNs通道
harmony: 鸿蒙通道

如果未配置此参数，则代表所有通道均可使用。
如果配置了此参数，则严格使用参数中的通道。
如果配置的通道和发送策略冲突（如iOS通知仅走APNs通道，但本参数中不包含apns），则不实施发送。
若配置gcm，则可以走谷歌GCM和FCM通道，若配置fcm，则只能走谷歌FCM通道
fields.name: send_channels

fields.help_en: [Deprecated] This parameter is deprecated
fields.help_zh: 该参数已废弃
fields.name: send_speed

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to save offline messages or notifications. Default value: false.
If this parameter is set to true and the user is offline during the push, the message or notification is sent again when the user comes online within the expiration time specified by ExpireTime. The default value of ExpireTime is 72 hours. iOS notifications are sent through the APNs channel and are not affected by the StoreOffline parameter
fields.help_zh:
离线消息/通知是否保存。StoreOffline默认设置为false。

若保存，在推送时候用户不在线，在过期时间（ExpireTime）内用户上线时会被再次发送。ExpireTime默认为72小时。iOS通知走APNs链路，不受StoreOffline影响
fields.name: store_offline

fields.help_en:
The push target. Valid values:
DEVICE: device
ACCOUNT: account
ALIAS: alias
fields.help_zh:
推送目标。可取值：

DEVICE：根据设备推送。
ACCOUNT：根据账号推送。
ALIAS：根据别名推送
fields.name: target

fields.help_en:
The target value, which is set based on the Target parameter. Separate multiple values with commas. If the number of values exceeds the limit, you must push the message in multiple batches.
If Target is set to DEVICE, the value is in the format of `deviceid1,deviceid2`. A maximum of 1,000 devices are supported.
If Target is set to ACCOUNT, the value is in the format of `account1,account2`. A maximum of 1,000 accounts are supported.
If Target is set to ALIAS, the value is in the format of `alias1,alias2`. A maximum of 1,000 aliases are supported
fields.help_zh:
根据Target来设定，多个值使用逗号分隔，超过限制需要分多次推送。

Target=DEVICE，值如`deviceid1,deviceid2`（最多支持1000个）。
Target=ACCOUNT，值如`account1,account2`（最多支持1000个）。
Target=ALIAS，值如`alias1,alias2`（最多支持1000个）
fields.name: target_value

fields.help_en:
The title of the notification or message during the push. Maximum length: 200 bytes.
This parameter is required for Android and HarmonyOS pushes. This parameter is optional for iOS notification pushes. If this parameter is specified:
For iOS 10 and later, the title is displayed in the notification.
For iOS 8.2 to iOS 9.x, the title replaces the application name in the notification
fields.help_zh:
推送时通知/消息的标题，长度限制：200字节。
在Android推送和Harmony推送时必填；在iOS推送通知时非必填，如果填写，则：
iOS 10+通知显示标题。
iOS 8.2 <= iOS系统 < iOS 10：替换通知应用名称
fields.name: title

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to automatically truncate excessively long titles and content.
Note: This parameter applies only to vendor channels that explicitly limit the length of titles and content. It does not apply to channels such as APNs, Huawei, and Honor, which do not limit the length of titles and content but only limit the total request body size
fields.help_zh:
是否自动对过长标题、内容进行截断。
注：仅支持明确限制标题、内容的厂商通道，对APNs、华为、荣耀通道等不限制标题、内容，只限制总请求体大小的不适用
fields.name: trim

fields.help_en:
To send iOS notifications through the APNs center, you must specify the corresponding environment context. Valid values:
DEV: development environment. This value applies to applications that are directly installed and debugged by using Xcode.
PRODUCT: production environment. This value applies to applications distributed through the App Store, TestFlight, Ad Hoc, and enterprise distribution
fields.help_zh:
iOS的通知是通过APNs中心来发送的，需要填写对应的环境信息。

DEV：开发环境，适用于Xcode直接安装调试的应用。
PRODUCT：生产环境，适用于 App Store、TestFlight、Ad Hoc 及企业分发的应用
fields.name: ios_apns_env

fields.help_en:
The badge number displayed in the upper-right corner of the iOS application icon.
If iOSBadgeAutoIncrement is set to true, this parameter must be left empty
fields.help_zh:
iOS应用图标右上角角标。

若iOSBadgeAutoIncrement设置为True，则此项必须为空
fields.name: ios_badge

fields.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable the automatic badge increment feature. Default value: false.
When this parameter is set to true, iOSBadge must be left empty.
The automatic badge increment feature maintains the badge count for each device on the push server. This feature requires SDK version 1.9.5 or later, and users must actively synchronize the badge number to the server
fields.help_zh:
是否开启角标自增功能，默认为false。

当该项为true时，iOSBadge必须为空。

角标自增功能由推送服务端维护每个设备的角标计数，需要用户使用V1.9.5以上版本的SDK，并且需要用户主动同步角标数字到服务端
fields.name: ios_badge_auto_increment

fields.help_en:
The extension property of the iOS notification.
For iOS 10 and later, you can specify the resource URL for a rich media push notification in this parameter, for example, `{"attachment": "https://www.example.com/notification_pic.png"}`. This parameter must be passed in JSON map format. Otherwise, a parse error occurs
fields.help_zh:
iOS通知的扩展属性。

iOS10+可以在此指定富媒体推送通知的资源Url：`{"attachment": "https://www.example.com/notification_pic.png"} `。该参数要以JSON map的格式传入，否则会解析出错
fields.name: ios_ext_parameters

fields.help_en:
The interruption level. Valid values:
passive: The system adds the notification to the notification list without turning on the screen or playing a sound.
active: The system displays the notification immediately, turns on the screen, and can play a sound.
time-sensitive: The system displays the notification immediately, turns on the screen, and can play a sound, but does not bypass the system notification controls.
critical: The system displays the notification immediately, turns on the screen, and plays a sound bypassing the silent switch
fields.help_zh:
中断级别，取值：

passive：系统在不点灯、不播放声音的情况下将通知添加到通知列表中。

active：系统立即显示通知，点亮屏幕，并可以播放声音。

time-sensitive：系统立即呈现通知，点亮屏幕，并可以播放声音，但不会突破系统通知控制。

critical：系统立即显示通知，屏幕亮起，并绕过静音开关播放声音
fields.name: ios_interruption_level

fields.help_en:
The JSON string that contains the static pass-through parameters for Dynamic Island pushes. Static parameter includes static user-defined information, such as product IDs and order information.
Static parameter is required when iOSLiveActivityEvent is set to start
fields.help_zh:
JSON字符串，灵动岛推送透传静态参数。包含静态的用户自定义信息，如产品编号、订单信息等。

iOSLiveActivityEvent为start时必填
fields.name: ios_live_activity_attributes

fields.help_en:
The type of the Live Activity to be started.
This parameter is required when iOSLiveActivityEvent is set to start
fields.help_zh:
待启动的Live Activity类型。
iOSLiveActivityEvent为start时必填
fields.name: ios_live_activity_attributes_type

fields.help_en: The dynamic parameter passed through for Dynamic Island pushes. This parameter includes real-time update information, such as price and inventory changes
fields.help_zh: 灵动岛推送透传动态参数，包含实时更新信息，如价格、库存变化等
fields.name: ios_live_activity_content_state

fields.help_en: The time until which the ended Live Activity remains on the Lock Screen. The maximum retention period is 4 hours
fields.help_zh: 结束的Live Activity在锁屏上会保留到该指定时间，最长为4小时
fields.name: ios_live_activity_dismissal_date

fields.help_en:
The event to start, update, or end a Live Activity. Valid values:
start: starts the Live Activity
update: updates the Live Activity
end: ends the Live Activity
fields.help_zh:
启动、更新、结束实时活动。

枚举：start | update | end
fields.name: ios_live_activity_event

fields.help_en: The Live Activity ID reported by the device to the user server. This is the unique identifier of the Live Activity
fields.help_zh: 由设备上报到用户服务器的Live Activity ID，Live Activity的唯一标识符
fields.name: ios_live_activity_id

fields.help_en: The second-level timestamp that marks the expiration time of the activity content
fields.help_zh: 秒级时间戳，标记该活动的内容过期时间
fields.name: ios_live_activity_stale_date

fields.help_en:
The sound of the iOS notification. Specify the name of the audio file stored in the app bundle or the Library/Sounds directory of the sandbox. For more information, see How to set the notification sound for iOS pushes.
If this parameter is set to an empty string (""), the notification is silent. If this parameter is not set, the default value "default" is used, which indicates the system prompt sound
fields.help_zh:
iOS通知声音。指定存放在app bundle或沙盒Library/Sounds目录下的音频文件名，请参见：iOS推送如何设定通知声音。

若指定为空串（””），通知为静音；若不设置，默认填充default为系统提示音
fields.name: ios_music

fields.help_en: The iOS notification processing extension flag (iOS 10 and later). If this parameter is set to true, notifications pushed by APNs can be processed by the extension before they are displayed. This parameter must be set to true for silent notifications
fields.help_zh: iOS通知处理扩展标记（iOS 10+）。如果设为true，则APNs推送的通知在弹出前，可先到达Extension进行处理。静默通知时，必须设为true
fields.name: ios_mutable_content

fields.help_en: The category of the iOS notification (iOS 10 and later)
fields.help_zh: 指定iOS通知Category（iOS 10+）
fields.name: ios_notification_category

fields.help_en: The collapse ID. If a device receives messages with the same collapse ID, the messages are merged into one. If the device is offline and continuously receives messages with the same collapse ID, only one notification is displayed in the notification bar. This parameter is supported in iOS 10 and later
fields.help_zh: 设备收到有相同CollapseId的消息，会合并成一条。设备不在线，连续发相同CollapseId的消息，通知栏只会显示一条，iOS 10+支持设置此参数
fields.name: ios_notification_collapse_id

fields.help_en: The thread ID used to group iOS remote notifications and mark the identifier of the collapsed group. This parameter is supported only in iOS 12.0 and later
fields.help_zh: 通过该属性对iOS的远程通知进行分组，标记折叠的组别识别名。仅支持iOS 12.0+版本
fields.name: ios_notification_thread_id

fields.help_en: The relevance score for summary highlighting. Valid values: floating-point numbers in the range of [0,1]
fields.help_zh: 摘要突出显示分数。取值范围：[0,1]的浮点数
fields.name: ios_relevance_score

fields.help_en:
If the device is offline during a message push (that is, the persistent connection channel to the mobile push server is disconnected), the message is delivered once as a notification through the Apple APNs channel.
Offline message-to-notification conversion applies only to the production environment
fields.help_zh:
消息推送时设备不在线（即与移动推送的服务端的长连接通道不通），则这条推送会做为通知，通过苹果的APNs通道送达一次。

离线消息转通知仅适用于生产环境
fields.name: ios_remind

fields.help_en: The iOS notification content used when an iOS message is converted to a notification. This parameter is valid only when iOSApnsEnv is set to PRODUCT and iOSRemind is set to true
fields.help_zh: iOS消息转通知时使用的iOS通知内容，仅当iOSApnsEnv=PRODUCT && iOSRemind为true时有效
fields.name: ios_remind_body

fields.help_en: Specifies whether to enable iOS silent notifications
fields.help_zh: 是否开启iOS静默通知
fields.name: ios_silent_notification

fields.help_en: The subtitle of the iOS notification (iOS 10 and later)
fields.help_zh: iOS通知副标题内容（iOS 10+）
fields.name: ios_subtitle

parameters.help_en: The array of independent push tasks
parameters.help_zh: 独立推送任务组成的数组
parameters.name: push_task

parameters.help_en:
An idempotency token used to prevent duplicate pushes caused by client retries. If you use the same IdempotentToken for calls within 15 minutes, only one push is performed. Subsequent calls return the result of the first successful push.


The parameter must be a standard 36-character UUID in the 8-4-4-4-12 format. Each valid character is a hexadecimal digit in the range of 0-9 or a-f, and it is case-insensitive.
This parameter only prevents duplicate pushes caused by retries. It does not prevent duplicate pushes caused by concurrent calls
parameters.help_zh:
用于防止API调用端重试造成服务端重复推送的一个幂等参数。15分钟内使用相同IdempotentToken进行调用时，只会进行一次推送，后续返回第一次成功推送的结果。


参数格式为标准36位UUID(8-4-4-4-12)，每个有效字符是0-9 或 a-f 范围内的一个十六进制的数字，不区分大小写。
此参数仅用于避免重试造成的重复推送，无法避免并发调用造成的重复推送
parameters.name: idempotent_token
